Comments.Comment: Using the Stepper device to control the filter

Play the phrase (a single playing a rhythm), then go to Modulation > Pitch, Panning or Cutoff to see how Stepper devices are cycling through values each time a note is received - thus creating a complex rhythmic pattern
The Stepper can be controlled via the Macro as well (the macro is set to control the internal offset of the Stepper device)
